A standard-plan customer has **30 calendar days from delivery** to request a return of an eligible item, which includes an unused backpack.

A couple of other conditions that apply to any return of the backpack:

- It must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition, with the original tags, accessories, and packaging as supplied when returned. (An indoor fit check alone doesn't disqualify it, but visible wear, stains, alterations, or missing parts can cause the return to be rejected.) 
- Fabrics can be spot-cleaned, but do not wash the item before returning it, since a washed item won't meet the "unwashed" condition above. 

If you held an active TrailPlus membership when you placed the order, your return window is longer — 45 calendar days from delivery. Let me know if you'd like help with anything else, like checking a specific order.

If your TrailPlus membership was active at the time you placed your order, your return window is **45 calendar days from delivery** for eligible items. Please note the membership had to be active when the order was placed; joining after placing an order does not extend its return window.

A few related conditions that still apply:
- Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition, with original tags, accessories, and packaging included when supplied.
- Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind.
- A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns (waived in some cases, such as a damaged or incorrect item).

Also, if any item arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what you ordered, please report it within 7 calendar days of delivery, ideally with your order ID, a short description, and photos of the item and packaging.

If you'd like me to check the status of a specific order, just share the order ID.

No, you're not out of luck. Final-sale status only blocks change-of-mind returns; it does not protect you when an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect.

Here's what the policies say:

- A final-sale bag that arrived with a broken zipper is still eligible for review. Final sale can't be used to deny a report of an item that was damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered.
- It also doesn't remove the limited warranty for a qualifying manufacturing defect.

To move forward:

- You should report the issue **within 7 calendar days of delivery**. Since it arrived broken yesterday, you're well inside that window.
- When you report it, include your **order ID**, a short description, and clear **photos of the bag and its packaging** when you can.
- After review, Aster & Row may offer a replacement, refund, or another appropriate resolution (a replacement depends on stock).
- If they confirm the item arrived damaged, you **will not be charged a return shipping fee**.

Note: the specific resolution isn't decided until a human reviews your case, so I can't promise a refund or replacement in advance. If you'd like, share your order ID and I can pull up the order so you have it ready to include in your report.

Yes — Canada is the only country Aster & Row currently ships to internationally.

**Delivery time to Canada:**
- Orders generally arrive within **5–9 business days after dispatch**. 
- There's usually **1–2 business days** for processing before dispatch. 
- Note that estimates may be extended by customs processing or carrier delays. 

**A couple of things to keep in mind:**
- Import duties, taxes, and brokerage charges are **not prepaid** by us — any charges assessed by Canadian authorities or the carrier are the recipient's responsibility. 
- For returns, Aster & Row does **not** provide prepaid labels for ordinary (change-of-mind) Canadian returns, so the customer covers return postage. If an item arrives damaged or incorrect and we confirm it, support will provide an appropriate resolution without an ordinary return fee. Direct exchanges aren't offered for Canadian orders — you'd return the item and place a new one.

No—Aster & Row does not currently ship to Germany. Our only supported international destination is **Canada**, and shipping to all other countries is not available at this time.

That said, I'd still like to flag for follow-up: since Germany isn't on the current supported list, if you were shown a checkout flow suggesting you could ship there, that may be an anomaly worth a human looking into. Otherwise, if you'd like, I can help with the available options—such as another recipient where Aster & Row does ship, or details on our domestic shipping.

No. Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty on any of its products. 

Instead, warranty coverage depends on the product type:
- Bags and backpacks: 2 years from the purchase date
- Drinkware: 1 year from the purchase date
- Packing cubes and other travel accessories: 1 year from the purchase date

 Note also that a product marked final sale still retains its limited warranty if it has a qualifying manufacturing defect.

No — just not the whole thing. For the Breeze Tumbler:

- **Lid**: Can go in the dishwasher on the top rack. 
- **Stainless-steel body**: Should be **hand-washed**, not placed in the dishwasher. 

So hand-wash the body and you can top-rack the lid. Also, please don't put any component in the microwave, and avoid abrasive scrubbers, which can damage the finish. 

One note: I'm seeing conflicting internal guidance on whether the body is dishwasher-safe (the product card says all components are dishwasher-safe with the top rack recommended, while the product care guide says the body should be hand-washed). Since these authoritative sources disagree, the safest interim guidance is to **hand-wash the body** as recommended in the care guide. Also keep in mind that damage from using a cleaning method that conflicts with the care guide is not covered by the limited warranty.
